response.sql: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS record_count, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN record_count > avg_count THEN avg_ratio END) AS avg_ratio, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN record_count > avg_count THEN record_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_records, AVG(CASE WHEN record_count > avg_count THEN record_count - avg_count END) AS avg_excess FROM source_stats CROSS JOIN benchmark

assumptions.assumption: Only funding sources with matched spatial records are included in the cross-source average.

alternatives.interpretation: Include funding sources found in projects even when they have zero spatial records.
alternatives.sql: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(s.domainregistry) AS record_count, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM projects AS p LEFT JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN record_count > avg_count THEN avg_ratio END) AS avg_ratio, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN record_count > avg_count THEN record_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_records, AVG(CASE WHEN record_count > avg_count THEN record_count - avg_count END) AS avg_excess FROM source_stats CROSS JOIN benchmark
